correctness.rationale: Cartesian priority recursion establishes exact event characterization; all overlapping interval geometries classified. For size K to LK the Poisson dependency sums are b1=O(n/K^5+K^-2), b2=O(n/K^4+K^-2). With K proportional to n^(1/3) these vanish, finite window means converge to 4/3(x^-3-y^-3), and the tail is controlled by first moments. Standalone verifier passed 1,622 exact rational checks n=2..7, not used as an asymptotic proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The earlier one-tree marginal theorems do not give events shared by two independent trees at identical ordered-key intervals. Spatial collisions require squared marginal probabilities and two-tree dependencies; summing size windows changes the exponent to one third. A general single-tree result does not dominate the present exact overlap event without additional arguments.

value.rationale: The largest exactly shared consecutive-key fringe block between independently generated indexes is a natural alignment invariant. Its n^(1/3) scale and full Fréchet law are structurally stronger than one-tree subtree-count formulas and delimit chance reuse of index blocks. The result is an asymptotic classification with a meaningful parameter-free limiting distribution.
